statement: The owner confirms that the website currently has no traffic and that synchronization is working. The connected GA4 overview returned zero sessions, active users, engagement rate, and key events; this result is consistent with the owner's statement and is not evidence of a synchronization failure.
source: Owner confirmation and GA4 via GSC Wizard

date_range.description: GA4 response reports no comparison-period data for this period; current overview returned zero metrics. Owner confirms current website traffic is absent.

freshness: Owner confirmation and live connector response on 2026-10-12
metric_definition: GA4 overview values returned by the connected API: Sessions 0, Active users 0, Engagement rate 0, Key events 0; interpreted alongside owner confirmation of no current traffic.
confidence_rationale: Owner explicitly confirms current absence of website traffic and healthy synchronization; API call returned structured zero metrics without connector error.
limitations: The zero-metric response does not independently prove that no event of any kind occurred.
No GA4 settings or integrations were changed.
alternative_explanations: No meaningful current website traffic, as confirmed by the owner, explains the zero metrics; the present evidence does not indicate a synchronization failure.
business_impact: Current low/no traffic limits the ability to evaluate conversion performance; the immediate priority is to validate agent data access and analysis workflows using available live and synthetic data.
next_step: Continue positive read-only acceptance tests for GSC and Wix, preserve GA4 synchronization as working, and revisit traffic analysis when meaningful site activity exists.

statement: The homepage audit reported 21 of 27 images without alt text (low severity), a 167-character meta description, four H1 headings, and a redirect from / to /en. GSC reported 2,528 impressions and 205 clicks for the homepage URL in the 2026-09-12 through 2026-10-09 window. Review relevant image alt text and localization/metadata before deciding whether edits are warranted.
source: GSC Wizard live on-page audit plus GSC page/query performance

date_range.description: GSC performance context window; on-page crawl performed 2026-10-12.

freshness: GSC settled through 2026-10-09; page crawl on 2026-10-12.
metric_definition: Homepage impressions/clicks from GSC; alt coverage = 6 of 27 images have alt text (21 missing); meta description length measured by crawler.
confidence_rationale: Live crawl and GSC page metrics returned explicit values. The business impact and priority of each suggested fix have not been tested.
limitations: Missing alt text is not proof of lost rankings or sales; image relevance should be assessed before adding descriptions.
The root URL redirects to /en and the crawled document language is en; intended language routing needs owner/business review.
alternative_explanations: Some decorative images may appropriately use empty alt attributes.
The /en redirect may be expected behavior for locale selection; verify intended multilingual behavior before proposing a change.
business_impact: Potential accessibility and search-context improvement if relevant images lack meaningful descriptions; no ranking, traffic, or revenue lift is quantified.
next_step: Review the 21 image instances and current multilingual routing with a human, then propose minimal metadata/alt changes only if appropriate; do not edit automatically.
